synthetic_disclaimer: DEMO MODE: Synthetic records were used solely to verify the code pipeline. These metrics do NOT represent real-world CIC-IDS2017 detection performance.

positive_class_definition.explanation: MALICIOUS (1) is the positive class so Recall measures attack detection rate and Precision measures alert fidelity.

why_accuracy_is_insufficient: Because benign network flows heavily outnumber attacks in real traffic, a classifier can score high Accuracy while missing attacks (False Negatives). Precision, Recall, F1-Score, FP/FN counts, and ROC-AUC are therefore essential.

false_positive_vs_false_negative_analysi.false_positive_consequences: False Positives flag normal BENIGN traffic as MALICIOUS, causing unnecessary alerts and analyst fatigue.
false_positive_vs_false_negative_analysi.false_negative_consequences: False Negatives miss real MALICIOUS attacks by labeling them BENIGN, allowing intrusions to proceed undetected.

selection_reasoning: Selected 'Random Forest' because it achieved the highest F1-Score (0.9735) and Recall (0.9821) for the MALICIOUS class on the held-out test set.
